title: Addictoud
body_html:
Tip: Unisex

Anahtar Notalar: Neo Oriental, Gourmand

’’ Addictoud is the scent of a journey born in the embrace of the night.’’

At first breath, deep wine and melting caramel pull you into a warm whirl.

Then jasmine emerges from the shadows, followed by the calming touch of cedar and sandalwood, lighting the path ahead. Moss and cashmere wood carry the quiet serenity of the earth to your skin.

As the fragrance deepens, the tale turns sweeter: cotton candy, vanilla, and tonka bean rise like a soft dream. In the base, amber, musk, cypriol, and oud leave behind a mystery worthy of the night.

Addictoud whispers a luxurious and unforgettable story onto your skin..

title: Eximious
body_html:
Type: Unisex

Key Notes: Neo Citrus, Woody

"The power of silent luxury comes to life in a genderless portrait of elegance."

A refined balance of freshness and depth reveals itself with a delicate sparkle of bergamot and lime, gently softened by juniper and subtly warmed with hints of nutmeg and coriander.

The opening impression is luminous yet restrained, an elegance that whispers rather than declares.

At its heart, a graceful bouquet of white florals unfolds, intertwined with soft powdery nuances.

Patchouli lends an earthy sophistication, while cashmere wood envelops the composition in a velvety, smooth embrace.

As it settles onto the skin, the base deepens into a musky-amber warmth.

Creamy vanilla blends with mossy accords, vetiver, and cedarwood, leaving behind a trail that is soft yet enduring—intimate, refined, and quietly powerful.

Bergamot, Lime, Juniper, Nutmeg, Coriander

Heart Notes (Floral – Woody):

title: L'ambre Vanille

‘’The Scent of an Instant Escape. A Seductive Signature.’’

L'ambre Vanillé is a luxurious defiance of the ordinary.

The First Act: Tropical Dreams. Close your eyes and surrender. Notes of coconut and creamy milk instantly transport you to a secluded beach. A soft, peaceful, and irresistible opening.

Mysterious Heartbeat: In the heart of the fragrance, the fire of adventure burns.

The mysterious, aromatic blend of rare Juniper and sacred resins—Myrrh, Labdanum, and Olibanum—adds a sophisticated depth.

The allure of undiscovered paths appears on your skin.

The Eternal Embrace: Like the warmth of the night... Melting Vanilla, Praline, and Tonka Bean in the base notes offer a seductive sweetness.

L'ambre Vanillé: Not just a scent, but a luxurious dream you wear.
